exposure: presence or absence of aggressive retinopathy of prematurity (A-ROP)
outcome: ROP diagnosed before admission or after admission
finding: There is no significant difference in the recurrence rate of ROP between ranibizumab injection and LP, and recurrence is mainly related to the severity of ROP.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in delivery mode between infants treated with laser photocoagulation and ranibizumab for retinopathy of prematurity.
